title.en: Amending Executive Order No. 955, Series of 1984, By Reducing the Rate Prescribed Therein to Five Percent (5%)
title.orig: Amending Executive Order No. 955, Series of 1984, By Reducing the Rate Prescribed Therein to Five Percent (5%)

text.en:
The rate of the additional import duly imposed under Executive Order No. 955, series of 1984, is
hereby reduced from ten per cent (10%) to five per cent (5%).

The other provisions of Executive Order No. 955, series of 1984, and the rules and regulations issued
pursuant thereto shall remain valid and effective.

This Executive Order shall take effect October 15, 1984 for petroleum, product imports, and on
January 1, 1985, for all other imports.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
eighty-four.
